text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains, with ETH outpacing BTC slightly, suggesting some rotation into altcoins despite the narrow moves. The Fear & Greed index at 22 indicates extreme fear has slightly moderated over the week, but the market remains deeply risk-averse; the $56B in daily volume is historically subdued, pointing to thin conviction behind these advances. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 55.6% shows investors are hedging rather than fleeing entirely, but the broader picture is one of cautious accumulation in a psychologically depressed environment.
